test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: M, N, O, P, Q, and R are seated at a circular table facing each other. O is to the immediate left of R and N is second to the left of O. M is second to the left of Q. Who sits immediately between R and M?
solution: As per the given information, the sitting arrangement is: 1. O is to the immediate left of R and N is second to the left of O.
